evidence: Current source and local Windows 0.62.2 API definitions read, edited and manually reviewed only. No builds, tests, syntax checks, project/game/module/renderer/JNI/shader/GPU execution, process inspection, native API calls or exports. Runtime parity remains unverified by user instruction.

source.actualInput: The existing successful public CreateRootSignature observer already supplies the actual returned root object and serialized API blob to tag_root. The existing public versioned deserializer supplies the converted 1.0 parameter/range declarations. This change copies range type, count and table-relative offset plus root flags; it does not infer an engine layout from object names, register guesses or recent draws.
source.privateTag: ARCRS002: 8-byte magic, little-endian u32 parameter count and root flags, then for each parameter u32 kind/constant-word-count/range-count. Range count UINT32_MAX means unknown or not applicable; other counts append kind/count/offset u32 triples. At most 64 parameters, 64 root DWORDs and 256 total range records; maximum private bytes 3856. Oversized/missing range metadata becomes unknown independently of known parameter kinds. Unknown whole layouts clear the existing private tag.
source.legacy: ARCRS001 remains readable with its exact 12+8*parameter-count layout. Its root flags and ranges stay unknown. It can preserve existing argument restoration history but cannot establish descriptor slot coverage.
source.stage: Graphics and compute Stage now retain the copied parameter/range metadata and optional flags alongside their original root/argument shadow. Changing the root clears both; redundant signature binding and existing heap-change table invalidation retain their original behavior.
source.actualHeaps: Use only the observed shader-visible bound heaps, at most one CBV/SRV/UAV heap and one sampler heap. Query each real heap's description, actual owning device, descriptor increment and actual CPU/GPU starts. Require the same canonical device as the live list, supported type/flags, nonempty count, nonzero increment/starts and non-overflowing heap handle extents. Raw numeric handles are never turned into COM pointers.
source.resolution: A table handle must be an aligned offset inside the actual heap of its declared range class. Explicit offsets use their declared table origin; APPEND uses the previous range's end. UINT32_MAX descriptor counts extend only to that heap's remaining slots. Count coverage is checked against the heap and a shared 256-descriptor budget across both stages; mixed sampler/resource tables, missing/unknown ranges, invalid handles, overflow or oversized coverage yield None for the whole optional plan.
source.directIndexing: Root CBV_SRV_UAV_HEAP_DIRECTLY_INDEXED and SAMPLER_HEAP_DIRECTLY_INDEXED flags have no declared table extent, so automatic table coverage remains unknown. Missing legacy flags cannot be substituted with zero. Shader-use reflection would be a separate producer.
source.retention: Each DescriptorSpan retains an Arc to its actual heap and records kind, first slot, count, increment and actual CPU/GPU handles. Snapshot retains all spans and their heap owners, so its existing clone/retirement path retains the slot-plan objects. Some(empty) means no declared table slots, Some(spans) means bounded declared coverage and None means unknown. No diagnostic exposes handles.
source.preserved: No descriptor is read, copied, rewritten or frozen. Actual restoration still writes its original heap/table handles and other saved arguments. Existing restorable/list/world/phase/resource ownership contracts and readiness gates remain unchanged. No public JNI, archive, packet or native hook ABI changes, new hooks, tests or test cases.

limits: The converted 1.0 range metadata deliberately omits register/space/shader-use reflection and 1.1 volatility/static-data flags. Slot coverage does not establish static descriptor contents, resource states, shader read extents or driver validation.
Unbounded tables larger than the explicit slot budget and direct heap indexing require a separately proven usage/ownership path; no arbitrary prefix stands in for them.

Public heap/view/sampler creation and descriptor-copy provenance now feed retained referenced-object cohorts and pre-emission revision checks (native-descriptor-resources-source.json). Complete native backing-allocation and frozen descriptor-content ownership remain unfinished.

Exclusive native phase/list ownership, authoritative material inputs and a game-facing draw insertion caller remain required. Live cosmetics/capes/emotes, deterministic replay video and full parity remain unfinished.
